report.assumptions: Exact supplied substochastic Markov reference: reward is paid before each transition. Stop probability is probability of requesting a step beyond the horizon. Omitted reward compares the same model with and without truncation. An unrelated graph, scheduler timeout or unknown uncapped model is not certified.

interval.assumptions: Independent proposal draws and prespecified support, allocation and hypothesis family. Zero empirical variance does not establish zero uncertainty.

report.assumptions: Finite target/proposal support and likelihood ratios checked exactly; samples come from that proposal using integer rejection sampling. Stratified means use target stratum masses and fixed allocations, not pooled counts. This supplied-law experiment is separate from arbitrary graph Weight expressions. Report moments use binary64; exact reference and design variance use rationals. No optional stopping.
